audience: A 24-year-old in Delhi who wears sunscreen through a 44° summer, has watched the viral 'we tested your sunscreen' videos, and no longer believes the number printed on the tube.
insight: Every tube says SPF 50. After the test videos, nobody takes the number on trust any more.
smp: SPF 50 on the label, 56.6 in the lab.
device: a lab gauge that tests the tube's printed claim live: a measuring bar with the label's 50 marked on it climbs on the build and lands past it at 56.6 on the drop, over a cut-out of her applying it on Minimalist orange
device_why: Minimalist's whole brand is published proof (ingredients with percentages, lab reports on the page); the gauge turns their lab report into a moment you watch happen

recall.does: SPF 56.6 and PA++++ in an independent lab, no white cast, light like a moisturiser
recall.why: the number on the tube is proven, not just printed

claims.text: SPF value obtained: 56.6, PA ++++ — in-vivo, ISO 24444:2019, Advanced Science Laboratories (independent third-party lab)
does not leave any white cast
spreads easily like a lightweight moisturiser

music.title: Tauba Tauba (From "Bad Newz")
music.why: the most-used Indian reel audio of its year; its groove stops dead for one beat and slams back — the stop holds 'par hai kya?', the slam lands SPF 56.6

look.why: Minimalist's own orange (the SPF line on the tube) as a full colour field: it reads as sun, it makes the white tube and her black top pop, and it's nothing like the last two (near-black, berry)

beats.says: SPF 50 likha hai. par hai kya?
beats.shows: the Minimalist SPF 50 tube lands on orange ('SPF 50' lifted out huge), then she squeezes it into her palm
beats.serves: voices the doubt every buyer has about the number on the tube

beats.shows: she dots it on her face (cut out on orange) while a lab readout panel measures: the bar climbs past nothing toward the label's 50; independent lab · in-vivo · ISO 24444
beats.serves: the brand answers with a test, not a promise

beats.shows: on the slam the readout lands past the 50 tick at 56.6, PA++++; she blends it in
beats.serves: the proof: more than the label claims, measured

beats.says: white cast? zero. moisturiser jaisa halka.
beats.shows: a close-up of her face after: no white cast; then she presses it in like a moisturiser
beats.serves: answers the next two doubts: does it leave a cast, does it feel heavy

beats.shows: the tube stands centre on orange between '50 likha.' and '56.6 nikla.'
beats.serves: lands the SMP as a line people will repeat

beats.shows: the tube, the Minimalist wordmark, the price and where
beats.serves: what to buy, what it costs, where (the lab report is on the page)
